title: Ruled feature grid cascade
summary: Four short feature points in a 2x2 grid on black. Each item's blue hairline draws from the left, then its three lines rise out of a clip mask in reading order; the grid holds, then rules retract and text fades.
use_when: A product page or pitch slide needs four short benefits shown at once
A text-only section between product shots in a longer film
A silent loop for a website hero or social feed
Points of equal weight that should read in a fixed order

look.type_style: bold grotesk, sentence case, normal tracking, about 3.6 % H, 3 lines per item, ragged left; a 6 px blue hairline above each item

sfx.event: each feature item lands (4 per film)

structure.shot: empty black, then a 2x2 grid of four feature items builds: blue hairline on top, a 3-line statement under it
structure.motion: order top-left, top-right, bottom-left, bottom-right, item stagger ~4 fr (±0.25 s); hairline draws from left, easings.outExpo ~12 fr (±0.25 s); each line rises out of its clip mask, line stagger ~4 fr (±0.25 s), springs.ui (overshoot not measurable); first rule f8, last line settles ~f45

structure.shot: the full grid holds: four items, two columns, two rows, all text white, all rules blue
structure.motion: hold 82 fr; nothing moves after the last line settles (sheet cells 1.77 to 4.00 identical)

structure.shot: the grid clears: hairlines shrink toward their right ends, text fades out, top row first
structure.motion: rules retract to the right, easings.inExpo ~10 fr (±0.25 s); text opacity fade ~6 fr (±0.25 s), top row leads bottom row by ~4 fr (±0.25 s); empty by f135

structure.shot: empty black, matching the first frame so the clip loops
structure.motion: none; 15 fr of black before the loop restarts

params.brand: any brand.json: display font, fg for the text, accent for the hairlines, bg
params.content.items: 4 feature statements, 6 to 8 words each, wrapping to 3 short lines
params.aspect: other (4:3 like the reference) | 16:9 | 1:1 | 4:5; 2 columns, 9:16 stacks into 1 column

notes: Measured from 4 fps sheets only (no strip): sub-0.25 s numbers carry ±0.25 s. Grid: column left edges at about 16 % and 56 % W, rule rows at 29 % and 55 % H; hairline about 30 % W long, 6 px thick, solid pixels #3D6AD6 (palettegen gives antialiased #819CD2 / #2D406A). Rules draw from the left and leave toward the right. Last line drifts up 2 to 3 px between 1.27 and 1.77 s (settle). Loop: first and last frames are both black. sfx planned by the glue rule, not measured (reference is silent). Proposed term: rule-draw (accent hairline draws on from one end, retracts to the other).
